```yaml
name: Security Scan

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  security-scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Install Ruff
        run: pip install ruff

      - name: Run Ruff check
        run: ruff check .

      - name: Run Ruff format check
        run: ruff format --check .

      - name: Run security scanner
        run: |
          python scripts/scan_plugin.py . || [ $? -eq 2 ]
```
